problemHeading: You already won the search. You are losing the answer.
problemBody: A homeowner with a leaking water heater used to type "plumber near me" and scroll. Now many ask an assistant, and it names one, two, or three companies. In BrightLocal's 2026 consumer survey, 45% of people said they had used AI tools to find local businesses. If the assistant doesn't have clear facts about you, it names someone else, even if you rank well on Google.

Earlier this year, two of our clients told us new customers said they'd found them through ChatGPT. One had a patient mention Claude by name. As Tim puts it: SEO answers "where do I rank." This answers "do I exist."
howHeading: How it works. Three steps, no meetings.

howSteps.title: Check (free, {instantTurnaround}).
howSteps.body: Tell us your business, trade, and city. We ask ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Claude 8 questions your customers really ask, through each company's official API, and show you how many you were named for. Add your email and we send the full 48-answer report.

howSteps.title: Setup ({setupDays} days, guaranteed).
howSteps.body: Pick a plan and check out online. You fill out a 10-minute form and add us as a manager on your Google Business Profile and your website. We never ask for passwords. We build a facts sheet for you to approve, then fix what AI reads. Delivered within {setupDays} days of your completed intake, or your $497 back.

howSteps.title: Keep or Grow (monthly).
howSteps.body: Every month we re-run the questions, fix anything that drifted, and add fresh content. You get a short written report: how often you were named, what we did, and what's next. Approvals and questions happen by email.

packageIntro: One price covers the measuring, the fixing, and the reporting. Here's what you actually get.

packageItems.title: Measure.
packageItems.body: A baseline of 15 questions × 3 assistants × 3 runs (135 answers) before we touch anything, then the same check every month, so you see the trend against where you started.

packageItems.title: Your facts sheet.
packageItems.body: One page with your services, service area, hours, licensing, warranty, and response times, written once and approved by you. Every fix we make uses it, so every source says the same thing.

packageItems.title: Google Business Profile tune-up.
packageItems.body: Categories, services, service area, hours, photos, and Q&A, plus regular posts every month.

packageItems.title: A site AI can read.
packageItems.body: Structured data (schema) and an FAQ section on your site, or a simple one-page site on your own domain if you don't have one.

packageItems.title: Listings cleanup.
packageItems.body: Your name, address, phone, and services made consistent on the major directories AI assistants pull from, and drift fixed every month.

packageItems.title: A fair review kit.
packageItems.body: A review-request process that follows FTC rules and Google's policies, so you ask every customer the same way.

packageItems.title: New content (Grow).
packageItems.body: Two new service or city pages a month and a competitor gap check, aimed at the questions where you're missing.

packageItems.body: A Setup Complete report, then a short written report every month, including the months the numbers dip.

faq.question: Can you guarantee ChatGPT will recommend me?
faq.answer: No. Nobody can. We improve the information AI assistants rely on and measure the result honestly every month.

faq.question: So what do you guarantee?
faq.answer: That your setup is delivered within {setupDays} days of receiving your completed intake form and manager access, or we refund your $497 setup fee in full. It covers our work, not what AI assistants say. If your setup was waived through the founding offer, there's no setup fee to refund.

faq.question: Will this get me more calls?
faq.answer: That's the goal, but we don't promise it. What we measure and report is how often you're named, as "named in X of N answers".

faq.question: Which AI assistants do you check?
faq.answer: ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Claude, through their official APIs. Google's AI answers (AI Overviews and AI Mode) are not measured. Google doesn't offer an API we can use for this under its terms. We still work on the Google signals you control (your Business Profile, site, and reviews), and every report says plainly that Google's AI answers aren't scored.

faq.question: What's the difference between the instant result and the full report?
faq.answer: The instant result asks each assistant each question once, 24 answers in all, and shows how many of the 8 questions you were named for. The full report runs every question a second time (48 answers), lists who was named instead, and gives you three things to fix first. A person checks the name matching before it's sent.

faq.question: How exactly do you run the check?
faq.answer: We send the same 8 questions, written the way homeowners ask, to ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Claude through each company's official API with web search on. Then we look for your business name and website in each answer. The full method is on our methodology page.

faq.question: Why do my results change from month to month?
faq.answer: AI answers vary from run to run and change as the assistants update. That's why we ask each question several times and report the trend against your first check.

faq.question: Will this replace my SEO?
faq.answer: No. SEO aims at search rankings. This focuses on whether AI assistants know, describe, and name your business. The two overlap and help each other.

faq.question: Do I have to get on a call?
faq.answer: No. Everything happens online and by email: the check, checkout, intake, approvals, and reports.

faq.question: Do you need my passwords?
faq.answer: No. You add us as a manager or collaborator, and you can remove us anytime.

faq.question: Do you write fake reviews or give customers gifts for reviews?
faq.answer: Never. That breaks FTC rules and Google's policies. We help you ask every customer the same way.

faq.question: How long until I see a change?
faq.answer: It varies. Assistants refresh on their own schedules, so some changes show up in weeks and others take months.

faq.question: What if I don't have a website?
faq.answer: Setup can include a simple one-page site on a domain you own.

faq.question: Can I cancel?
faq.answer: Yes, anytime, online, from the private billing link we email you. There's no six-month agreement. Service runs through the month you paid for.

faq.question: What's the founding offer?
faq.answer: Our first 10 clients get the $497 setup waived if they agree to let us publish their results as a case study, with their approval of the write-up.

faq.question: Are the reviews on this page about Revvia AI Visibility?
faq.answer: No. They're reviews of Revvia, the marketing firm behind this product, from clients of our agency work. Revvia AI Visibility is new. We'll add its own results as founding clients approve their case studies.

faq.question: I already work with Revvia, or I want more than this. What now?
faq.answer: Reply to any of our emails. If you need ads, a full new site, strategy, or more locations, Tim Holt will follow up personally about Revvia's fractional CMO work.

faq.question: Who's behind this?
faq.answer: Revvia, a founder-led marketing firm in Carlsbad, California, run by Tim Holt since 2020.
